title: Your life moves in the direction of your strongest thoughts.
paragraphs: Your life moves in the direction of your strongest thoughts.
“Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.” — Romans 12:2
Your mind is the steering wheel of your life.

If your thoughts are filled with fear, your life will move toward fear.
If your thoughts are filled with lies, your life will follow those lies.
But when your mind is renewed by the truth of God’s Word, everything begins to change.
Transformation doesn't begin with changing your circumstances.
It begins with changing what you believe.
God renews your life by renewing your mind.
